about.p1: We connect customers with trusted local sound & DJ rental vendors for weddings, birthdays, religious events, jagrans, orchestras and DJ nights.
about.p2: Vendors manage their own equipment, packages and bookings on our platform, while customers get a simple way to check availability, pay an advance online, and receive an instant receipt.

contact.subtitle: Have a question? Send us a message and we'll get back to you.
contact.thank_you: Thank you! We'll get back to you soon.

privacy.p1: When you make a booking, we collect your name, phone number, email, address and event details in order to confirm and fulfil your booking with the relevant vendor.
privacy.p2: Your information is shared only with the sound/DJ vendor you book with, so they can deliver equipment and contact you about your event. We do not sell your data to third parties.
privacy.p3: Advance and balance payments are processed via UPI/QR or recorded manually by the vendor; we do not store your full payment card details.
privacy.p4: If you have questions about this policy, please reach out via the Contact Us page.
